{{Infobox character|name=Old Corvin|house=[[House Ravenshade]] (in service)|role=Archivist|age=~70}}
'''Old Corvin''' has kept [[House Ravenshade]]'s archives for fifty years. He is loyal to the archive, not the family, and cannot be bought — which frightens everyone. It is said he keeps one puzzle of his own: an entry in the oldest ciphers that points toward a name no one can fill in.
